facts.text: I am a CEO at askFundu.
askFundu is a finance-focused social network.
askFundu focuses on user queries related to finance.
askFundu encourages users to ask finance-related questions.
askFundu is trying to engage users on the platform by providing a personalized feed.
The personalized feed includes news excerpts.
The personalized feed includes prediction content where other users make stock market predictions.
The personalized feed includes other user queries.
